_real_world.variant_scope: F414-GE-400 as fitted to F/A-18E/F Block II/III Super Hornet and EA-18G Growler (twin-engine installation)

_provenance.modeling_note: F414-GE-400 turbofan powering CVW-8's F/A-18E/F and EA-18G. The CSG order-of-battle page does not carry per-engine thrust (only airframe-level performance), so this record uses a targeted web search of GE Aerospace/MTU public engine specifications for thrust, SFC, and bypass ratio.

engine.mil_thrust_n.note: 13,000 lbf military (dry) thrust per Wikipedia/GE Aerospace-sourced spec; 13000 x 4.4482 = 57826.6 N

engine.ab_thrust_n.note: 22,000 lbf (98 kN) afterburning thrust class, confirmed by GE Aerospace and MTU product leaflet; 22000 x 4.4482 = 97860.4 N

engine.sfc_mil.note: 0.840 lb/hr/lb dry SFC (23.9 g/kN.s), Wikipedia-carried public figure, uncited primary source (citation needed) so treated as C-est

engine.sfc_ab.note: 1.850 lb/hr/lb afterburner SFC (49.3 g/kN.s), same C-est caveat as sfc_mil

engine.bypass_ratio.note: 0.25:1 bypass ratio, same Wikipedia performance table, same C-est caveat
